title: Accounting and Tax Services for Shoe Stores

rows.before: We incorporated the boutique under the Ontario Business Corporations Act, moved inventory, fixtures and goodwill across on a section 85 rollover with no gain triggered, applied the $500,000 Small Business Deduction so active income is taxed near 12.2%, wrote deadstock down to net realizable value under section 10, and moved gift cards to deferred revenue with breakage.
rows.after: We incorporated the boutique under the Ontario Business Corporations Act, moved inventory, fixtures and goodwill across on a section 85 rollover with no gain triggered, applied the $500,000 Small Business Deduction so active income is taxed near 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026), wrote deadstock down to net realizable value under section 10, and moved gift cards to deferred revenue with breakage.
rows.note: Case-study result stated without a date as the current SBD-taxed rate; treated as current. If Sharad dates this engagement before July 1, 2026, switch to R3 (leave).

rows.before: Cut the combined tax bill materially at the 12.2% rate
rows.after: Cut the combined tax bill materially at the 11.2% rate
rows.note: Case-study result stated without a date as the current SBD-taxed rate; treated as current. If Sharad dates this engagement before July 1, 2026, switch to R3 (leave).
